capabilities: Sync a vault across devices via a self-hosted Node server
Auto sync on a timer, vault events, and WebSocket push notifications
Keep conflicting edits as conflict-named files or take the server version
Share notes via share links and a shared notes view
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is developer-oriented (repo structure, CLI, API endpoints) rather than end-user setup instructions, and it does not state where to install the server besides a Termux deploy path.
intentEvidence: Self-hosted Obsidian vault sync — fresh rewrite of eari-sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through a server you host yourself, so self-hosting users need their own client and server.

relations.evidence: Self-hosted Obsidian vault sync — fresh rewrite of eari-sync.

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin and Node server that keeps a vault in sync across desktop and mobile devices, with conflict handling and note sharing.
